def normalize_toc_item(md: 'Markdown', token: Dict[str, Any]) ->Tuple[int,
    str, str]:
    try:
        level = token['attrs']['level']
        tid = token['attrs']['id']
        children = token.get('children', [])
        if isinstance(children, list):
            text = striptags(md.render_inline(children))
        else:
            text = striptags(str(children))
        return (level, tid, text)
    except (KeyError, AttributeError, TypeError):
        # Fallback for malformed tokens
        level = token.get('attrs', {}).get('level', 1)
        tid = token.get('attrs', {}).get('id', '')
        text = ''
        return (level, tid, text)
